_comment: Committed expected-GA capability-manifest snapshot for honua-release#61's live capability-manifest canonical check (e2e/canonical_checks.py:check_capability_manifest). Seeded from a real fetch of https://demo.honua.io/api/v1/capabilities/manifest (schemaVersion honua.capability_manifest.v1, 29 ids, all supported=true) minus two deliberately-gated ids listed in `excluded`. `expectedGa` (minus `excluded`) is the id set every deployed candidate must advertise as supported=true; when the check runs authenticated (an admin X-API-Key) it also asserts available=true for the same set. Update this file (with a fresh sourceSnapshot) when the server adds/removes a GA capability id or when an excluded id's gating status changes.

excluded.reason: Gated: Enterprise-edition mTLS client-certificate auth, disabled-by-configuration on public/demo deployments. honua-server#2958 will reclassify this capability from GA to experimental — tracked there, not asserted as universally-GA here.

Gated: disabled-by-configuration (geofence enter/exit alerting is not enabled on every deployment profile). Present in the manifest as supported=true but not asserted available on a bare/demo deployment.
